issues.description: The problem statement/UML specifies the attribute `numberOfLecturers` as type `int`, but the solution declares it as `byte`. This conflicts with the specification and can mislead students about the required field type (and any tests expecting an `int`).
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution field `numberOfLecturers` to `int` (and adjust any dependent signatures accordingly) to match the UML/problem statement; alternatively, update the UML/problem statement to explicitly require `byte` if that is the intended type.
